projects.title: Collab
projects.description: A collaborative platform connecting professors and students based on shared interests. Features individual profiles, organized news feeds, and communication tools built with Laravel, Vue.js, and real-time messaging.

projects.title: DiveinPlayer
projects.description: A complete JavaFX-based media player built from scratch without external libraries. Features automatic file discovery, playlist management, and supports both music and video playback.

projects.title: SpaceWar
projects.description: A classic space shooting game inspired by NES-style arcade games. Features 4 levels, scoring system, and fast-paced gameplay developed using C/C++ and iGraphics.

projects.title: Inspect
projects.description: An online tech news platform with customizable content management. Built with a custom PHP framework to control HTML, CSS, and assets for dynamic content delivery.

projects.title: Pong
projects.description: Classic Pong game implementation developed in C/C++. A simple yet engaging recreation of the iconic arcade game with smooth gameplay mechanics.
